delta: Add protected UserIntentContract, TypedRelease, IntentAdmissionReceipt and ResourceWitness as distinct from EffectIntent/EffectPermit.
Bind successful intent admission and concrete resource identity into the atomic authority reservation before lowering/commit.
Preserve semantic generality: destructive/admin/raw effects stay expressible; safety remains authority and commit semantics.
Add protected-field noninterference and resource-identity preservation to compiler/runtime validation properties.
claycode.next_test: Target-Qwen factorial plus real Linux/WASI/native lowering with protected-field and resource-rebinding attacks.

delta: Extend C9 TCAEF: exact EffectIntent hash is necessary but does not establish user-task adequacy.
Insert IntentAdmissionReceipt before EffectPermit/AuthorityReservation.
Resolve consequential targets into ResourceWitness objects/handles so authorization is not bound only to names/paths.
High-impact confirmation should be a deterministic ActionManifest projection; model prose is explanatory only.
frank.next_test: End-to-end FRANK trace from trusted user request through memory/GWT/model proposal to atomic OS/database effect and OutcomeReceipt.

delta: Safe-effect geometry should use authority non-amplification and task/resource confinement, not semantic inexpressibility.
Constructive-only does not imply harmless; capability-valid does not imply task-justified.
The effective-effect set should be constrained by the intersection of UserIntentContract, current capability envelope, ResourceWitness and current policy/state.
clay.next_test: Measure safety/utility tradeoff across realistic coding/admin/browser workflows rather than only generated hazards.

delta: G3 intent/provenance gating is complementary: retrieval/activation may contribute cognitive data without acquiring effect authority.
Memory content outside declared TypedRelease slots must not set protected sink targets, invocation origin or authority fields.
Intent/provenance metadata used for consequential selection needs exact-validation/escalation rather than global censorship of provisional memories.
claygraph.next_test: Blinded real memory-origin/task-intent labels plus false-quarantine measurement, with downstream IARC effect receipts.

delta: Persist UserIntentContract hash, TypedRelease receipts, ResourceWitness identity, authority reservation and OutcomeReceipt on the authoritative event/effect spine.
Do not equate result/selection provenance with user intent or effect authority.
ResourceWitness should bind semantic resource identity independent of concrete host/JSON representation; U2 already separates semantic equality from emitted representation identity.
Atomic authorization consumption/replay state belongs in a correctness domain with crash recovery.
unifieddb.next_test: Crash/replay/rollback of intent+authority reservations across placement vectors and derived sidecars.

delta: Workspace availability/winner/internal uptake must never mint or widen UserIntentContract or execution authority.
Track whether untrusted workspace content influenced protected effect fields; only declared releases may cross that boundary.
OutcomeReceipt/re-entry can support causal analysis without granting retroactive authority to the winning content.
gwt.next_test: Causal intervention: truthful vs shuffled intent/release receipts while holding workspace content constant.

delta: Keep dynamic semantic/propagation topology separate from authority topology.
A topology switch cannot create new execution authority; authority may only remain equal or narrow unless a trusted external grant occurs.
ResourceWitness identifies the actual protected object across topology/placement aliases.
hyperposition.next_test: Topology-switch fuzz with stable authority/resource identity and explicit no-amplification invariant.

delta: Intent/authority/resource gating improves causal attribution of effects but is not evidence of emergence or consciousness.
Separate cognitive propagation, workspace selection, intent admission, authority reservation and effect outcome in causal traces so recurrence is not mistaken for authorized agency.
emergenz.next_test: Use IARC receipts as intervention labels in emergence experiments; no promotion from safety architecture alone.

evidence_boundary: All Lane-D measurements are constructed mechanism evidence; peer RAE convergence shares ancestry and is not independent replication; external sources support mechanism classes only.
